traits.name: Cat's Curiosity
traits.text: A silvanshee's core value is curiosity. This enables them to seek out new experiences and information beyond their current understanding. A silvanshee can use trained skill actions for all skills, even if they're untrained.

traits.name: Champion Focus Spell
traits.text: DC 16, 1 Focus Point; 1st lay on hands (Core Rulebook 387)

traits.name: Cat's Grace
traits.text: When a silvanshee uses their gaseous form spell, the mist form remains roughly the size and shape of a cat, and the silvanshee retains their fly speed in this form.
